answer.verdict: Arena is the only unstable stage: 37.27 fps avg, min 37, all 30 fight seconds under 58, GS 605 ms, ~1236 state-change batches/frame. The other nine stages hold 60 fps with sound on (GS 74-224 ms).

Pre-confirm card matched every asked stage. Closest distance vs next: airport 11.7/48.8, building 0.1/58.3, mall_a 0.0/47.6, mall_b 6.7/47.6, shinjuku 1.5/53.8, beach 12.4/70.9, laboratory 3.0/44.9, parking 0.5/48.7, underground 0.0/47.8, arena 14.4/61.8. Fight-on frames at fight+3 are non-blank 640x448. Means r/g/b: airport 74.4/71.2/80.3, building 80.3/73.1/70.9, mall_a 111.7/92.5/71.9, mall_b 73.0/69.9/51.5, shinjuku 88.8/74.4/66.7, beach 127.0/118.5/133.0, laboratory 91.1/93.4/113.4, parking 94.6/86.1/67.7, underground 76.5/62.9/45.2, arena 77.2/66.9/64.4. Same second GS is fight-level (airport 229 ms, arena 609 ms), not the ~3 ms command-list/menu.

Arena profile run (logs/grok/sweep-arena-prof, fight avg 36.73 fps GS 603.8): game thread 7536 samples, 56.5% NtWaitForAlertByThreadId, 3.1% SoundEngine::drainOutput, 1.7% PS2Memory::processVIF1Data, 1.6% VU1Interpreter::runNative. Other threads 113040 samples of 15: waits first (NtWaitForWorkViaWorkerFactory 26.7%, ZwWaitForSingleObject 26.6%), first GS work GSMem::ReadIndexRun 2.9%, then DrvPresentBuffers 0.5%, hashBlocks 0.3%, GSMem::WriteRun 0.3%.

Arena batches/frame 1236 = mean state batch-ends 226978 over six steady ~5 s fight windows / (36.73 fps * 5). Representative window state=228555 diffs tex0=174980 clamp=160822 texsize=126812 alpha=100369 abe=81020 test=14803.

fix.where: GS hw batching, arena stage only (next task; not edited here)
fix.change: Arena emits ~1236 state-change batches per frame, diffs dominated by tex0, clamp, texsize, alpha, abe. Game thread is 56.5% NtWaitForAlertByThreadId waiting on that. Coalesce or cache those uniforms so a batch survives across prims. Other stages are already 60 fps and do not need it.

contra: Airport is not perfectly flat: one second at 58 frames (perf second 99, GS 241). avg 60.00 and s<58=0, so it does not meet the unstable rule (avg < 59.5 or more than 2 seconds under 58).

1236 batches/frame uses the profile run's 36.73 fps times 5 s as the frame count. The gs-hw lines have no timestamps; the six windows are the steady state=225545-228555 cluster, not a proven alignment to perf seconds 73-102.

stage_card.py's STAGES array starts at arena, while Right-from-slot order in run_fixed_fight.ps1 is airport..arena. Measured cards matched the script order, so the array order is the reference-file index, not the press order.
